note: NORMATIVE (gate item 2). Declaration [assessment] confirmed by use (D.12 audit): tools that assess must understand or halt. Payload may be flat (per-object) or by-statement keyed where per-clause (D10 rev keying rule applies to the by-statement form). Absorbs documentation duties x966 (BSI/ISM), CR26 artifacts/examples/key-tests, CIS assessment-objectives, and the benchmark audit/remediation/method shape. 1.1.0 (2026-11-14, backlog #83, the author's decision): `objectives` is typed. An objective has an id, a label, prose, the objectives under it (`children`) and `assessment-for`: what it assesses, as a list of addresses. An address names a statement of the host Requirement (`statement-id`), a statement of another Requirement (`requirement-ref` with `statement-id`), or a Requirement as a whole (`requirement-ref` alone); a reference of the source that names nothing is carried as `href`. A `statement-id` in an address is held as a `by-statement` key is held (D10). `methods` lists the assessment methods a source states for the Requirement or for one objective (SP 800-53A: EXAMINE, INTERVIEW, TEST, each with its objects). `method`, singular, is unchanged: how an Assessment or a Check was carried out. Measured on SP 800-53A: 3,707 objectives name what they assess. 1.0.0 stays in the library: a bundle that pins it is held to it.
